title: Shortest first
hints: slices.Sort always uses the natural order, which for strings is alphabetical. To sort by something else, use slices.SortFunc with a comparison function.
The comparison function returns a negative number if a sorts before b, a positive number if after, and 0 if they're equal. cmp.Compare(len(a), len(b)) does exactly that for the lengths.
slices.SortFunc(words, func(a, b string) int { return cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(len(a), len(b)), strings.Compare(a, b)) })
